text:
Talia: Huge shoutout to Kira and Omar for jumping on the late-night alert and patching the staging timeout. Saved our partner demo this morning. :raised_hands:
Omar: wild 2am pivot but glad we caught it. Kira's fix was the key. :sparkles:
Kira: team effort  Diego ran the rollback, Rhea updated the runbook. Felt smooth!
ops-bot: incident logged: staging-timeout-2026-03-21 | resolved by Omar, Kira, Diego | no customer impact. :white_check_mark:
Diego: tiny celebratory plan: sticker tokens + a small note jar on the kitchen whiteboard? low-friction kudos for micro-wins.
Rhea: love that. also proposing "sealed with a sticker" ritual  people take a sticker when someone helps and stick it on their name.
Talia: poll: react with :label: for stickers, :card_index: for handwritten notes.
Omar: :label: stickers all the way.
Kira: :label: + can we have three designs: "Demo Saver", "Runbook Hero", "Snack Champion"
Diego: I'll print 50 stickers with space to write initials and date. Will set up the jar by tomorrow.
Rhea: I'll add a one-line entry to Friday digest: "micro-win: Kira/Omar fixed staging timeout, prevented partner-facing issue"
Talia: GIF for the digest: https://giphy.com/gifs/teamwork-3oEduQAsYcJKQH2XsI
Omar: anyone want to volunteer to stick the first batch on the board after standup? 2 minutes.
Kira: happy to do it. Thanks everyone  this was a real team save.
Talia: thanks all  bringing snacks tomorrow as a small thank-you. :cookie:
